user.title: Add an AR Remote

data_description.off_action: Optional extra action at Room Off. Room Off always pauses the music and turns off every source, amp and anything an activity turned on.
data_description.lights: Dimmable lights get a slider on the remote; switches and relays are on / off.
data_description.off_lights: On: the room goes completely dark at Room Off. Off: Room Off leaves the lights alone.
data_description.off_extra: Anything else that must be off when the room is off — fans, a heater, a TV that isn't in an activity. A **button**, script or scene here is pressed / run (e.g. a projector-off button).
data_description.off_delayed: These stay on after Room Off and switch off by themselves. A **button** here is pressed when its time is up (e.g. projector off after the lamp cools). Starting an activity that uses one cancels its timer.
data_description.off_delay_minutes: How long the devices above keep running after Room Off. After Submit, the next page lets you give each device its own time.

add_activity.title: Add an activity
add_activity.description: An activity is what the room is doing — like Watch Apple TV. While it runs, the remote's hard buttons drive these devices.

data.name: Activity name
data.devices: Also turn on (projector, amp, screen … or a button that turns one on)
data.power_on: Extra action when the activity starts (optional)

data_description.volume: Volume, mute and the volume rocker go here. Leave empty to use the source.
data_description.dpad: A remote entity — Apple TV, Android TV, Roku, Samsung, LG or a Broadlink/IR remote.
data_description.command_set: Which command names the navigation remote understands.
data_description.devices: Projector, amplifier, screen, power switches — or an IR / RF **button**, script or scene that switches something on (it is pressed when the activity starts). Switches and players go off at Room Off (or when the next activity doesn't use them); a button can't be switched off, so put its matching **off** button on the room's Room Off lists. Media players can be sent to an input on the next page.
data_description.power_on: A script or scene to run as well. For lights, delays and more, use the next pages.
data_description.logo: Already have the image in Home Assistant? e.g. `/local/netflix.png`. Leave both empty for the Watch / Listen icon.
data_description.logo_upload: Pick an image from your computer or phone (PNG or JPG; square looks best). Shown on the remote's Watch / Listen picker.

buttons.title: Buttons for {activity}
buttons.description: The three custom buttons appear on screen. The colour keys are the red, green, blue and yellow hard buttons; their labels show on screen too.

sources.title: Inputs for {activity}

data.source_input: Source — app or input to open (empty = leave it)
data.input: Volume device — input to switch to (empty = stays on whatever it's on)
data.start_volume: Volume device — set the volume to (empty = don't change)
data.input_delay: Wait before switching inputs and volume

data_description.input: Only if the amp / soundbar also switches the picture or sound source, e.g. a Denon set to GAME or TV AUDIO. Leave empty if it should just stay where it is.
data_description.start_volume: 0–100 %. Set when the activity starts. Leave empty to keep the current volume.
data_description.input_delay: Gives the amp, projector and TV time to wake up after they're switched on. If everything was already on, inputs switch straight away. A device already on the right input is left alone.

actions.title: What else {activity} does
actions.description: Optional. Pick devices to switch off or pulse at the top — each gets its own timer on the next page. Below, build anything else like an HA script: other devices and sources, dim or colour lights, delays between steps (e.g. wait 2 s).

data.stop_actions: When the activity ends (switching away or Room Off)
data.turn_off_on_end: Turn off everything the start steps turned on when the activity ends
data.off_on_start: Turn off when the activity starts
data.pulse: Turn on for a few seconds, then off again

data_description.turn_off_on_end: Lights, switches and players used in the start steps go off at Room Off or when you switch to an activity that doesn't use them. Music is paused first.
data_description.off_on_start: Things that may already be on but must be off for this activity (a light, another TV, a fan). A button / script here is pressed instead. Each gets its own delay on the next page — 0 is straight away.
data_description.pulse: Each comes on when the activity starts and switches itself off after its own number of seconds (next page) — e.g. a light that flashes on while everything powers up, or a screen-drop relay.

remote_settings.title: Remote settings
remote_settings.description: How the remote itself behaves. Clients can change brightness, Wi-Fi, the logo clock and a few more on the remote (swipe down from the top); installer settings there are behind the PIN below.

data.splash_seconds: Show the logo at start-up for
data.charging_screen: Show the charging screen when the remote is put on charge
data.clock_after: Show the clock after (no key pressed)
data.pickup: Wake the screen when the remote is picked up
data.key_REWIND_action: ⏪ key — action (when set to Run an action)
data.key_PLAY_action: ⏵ key — action (when set to Run an action)
data.key_STOP_action: ⏹ key — action (when set to Run an action)
data.key_FASTFORWARD_action: ⏩ key — action (when set to Run an action)

data_description.logo: e.g. `/local/logo.png`. Clear it (and don't upload) for the built-in A&R Smart Home logo.
data_description.splash_seconds: 0 turns the start-up logo off. Note: Android's own boot animation before the app starts can't be changed without rooting the remote.
data_description.pickup: Auto works on any remote: it keeps the motion sensor running while the screen is off (uses some battery). Battery saver only uses low-power sensors, which many remotes don't have. Lifting it off the charger always wakes it. The **Pick-up sensor** entity shows what the remote is using.
data_description.pickup_sensitivity: High wakes on a gentle lift; Low needs a firmer pick-up (fewer accidental wakes from bumps).
data_description.logo_upload: Pick an image from your computer or phone. A PNG with a transparent background looks best on the dark screen. Leave empty to keep the current logo.
data_description.clock: Your logo as a clock face. On the charger, the screen stays on and the clock appears instead of going dark; any key or tap goes back. Always also shows it off the charger (keeps the screen on — uses a lot of battery).
data_description.installer_pin: Protects **Installer settings** on the remote's pull-down panel (Android settings, restart, updates). Leave empty to keep the current PIN. Only a hash is stored.
data_description.clock_x: Leave both empty for automatic (the A&R logo's circle, or the middle of another logo). For the A&R logo the circle is at 50.4 % across, 37.1 % down.
data_description.key_REWIND: What the four media keys do. By default each opens the screen its icon shows. **Play controls** is the old behaviour (rewind / play / stop / forward on the source). **Run an action** runs the script, scene or button picked below it, on any screen.

copy_activity.title: Copy an activity
copy_activity.description: Makes a copy with the same devices, inputs, start/end steps and buttons. Next you can change what's different, like the name, logo and the app on the source.

data.name: Name of the copy

room_timers.title: Room Off timers for {room}
room_timers.description: How long each device keeps running after Room Off before it switches itself off. Every device has its own time. The timers survive a Home Assistant restart.

timers.title: Timers for {activity}
timers.description: One time per device, in seconds. **Turn off after**: how long after the activity starts it goes off (0 = straight away). **Stay on for**: how long the device stays on before it switches itself off.
